mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% year-over-year signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If CPIAUCSL YoY > 2% does not lead to negative 20-day forward returns in more than 60% of the instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4% signals a tight labor market, which leads to wage inflation and higher costs for businesses, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE < 4% does not lead to negative 60-day forward returns in more than 50% of the instances.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in Real Personal Consumption Expenditures (RSAFS) signals strong consumer demand, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If RSAFS increase does not lead to positive 5-day forward returns in more than 55% of the instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in Industrial Production Index (INDPRO) signals a slowdown in economic activity, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO decreases by more than 1% MoM
failure_condition: If INDPRO decrease does not lead to negative 20-day forward returns in more than 60% of the instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals an easing monetary policy, which leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS decrease does not lead to positive 60-day forward returns in more than 55% of the instances.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in Nonfarm Payrolls (PAYEMS) signals strong job growth, which boosts consumer spending and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If PAYEMS increase does not lead to positive 20-day forward returns in more than 55% of the instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in Housing Starts (HOUST) signals a slowdown in the housing market, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST decreases by more than 5% MoM
failure_condition: If HOUST decrease does not lead to negative 60-day forward returns in more than 60% of the instances.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and a decrease in Real GDP (GDPC1) signals a tightening monetary policy and economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS increases by more than 0.25% and GDPC1 decreases by more than 0.5% QoQ
failure_condition: If the joint condition of FEDFUNDS increase and GDPC1 decrease does not lead to negative 20-day forward returns in more than 60% of the instances.
